messages:
Anya (People Ops): Heads up — Ravi's role is moving to on-site at Acme client in Newark, NJ starting 2026-04-15. Legal flagged that an H‑1B amendment (new LCA + amendment filing) is required. Tagging @Jordan and @Olivia to coordinate next steps.

Jordan Patel: Ack. Client asked if we can get him there earlier for ramp/training. If amendment takes a while can Ravi do a short training visit?

Olivia Torres (Immigration): We need the LCA posted at both Redwood and the client worksite addresses for 10 business days before filing. Recommend premium processing for the amendment — speeds to ~2 weeks. Without premium it's 2–6 months. Please share exact worksite address and expected onsite schedule.

Ravi Kumar: I can delay full relocation if needed. Quick Q — does this change my benefits or state tax withholding? Want to know before booking travel.

Mike Chen: If the worksite is in NJ, state withholding may change once payroll address changes. If Ravi remains on CA payroll until amendment effective, benefits enrollment/eligibility stays the same. We need final work address and effective date before payroll cutoff (next cutoff 2026-04-10).

Anya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Jordan confirm exact client address. 2) Olivia to draft LCA and amendment forms. 3) Mike to review payroll cutoff & tax impact. 4) Ravi to confirm travel availability + e-sign consent. Posting template below (we'll use this text for the 10‑day LCA notice):

```
LCA posting notice
Employee: Ravi Kumar
Position: ML Engineer
Worksite: 100 Main St, Newark, NJ 07102 (Acme Client)
Start: 2026-04-15
Duration: 6+ months
Contact: Anya (People Ops)
```

Olivia Torres (Immigration): Also need a signed consent form from Ravi for amendment filing and a copy of his passport + previous I‑94. Ravi — please complete the consent via the DocuSign link I just sent.

Ravi Kumar: I got the DocuSign, just completed and sent back. :white_check_mark:

Anya (People Ops): Posting scheduled for today — I'll upload screenshots to the case file. We'll monitor the 10 business days and then Olivia will file with premium processing. Jordan, if the client insists on earlier dates we can approve a short training visit (travel paid) but full on‑site work will wait until amendment is approved.

Jordan Patel: That works. We'll plan a training visit for Apr 20–22 and keep full start as Apr 15 contingent on amendment. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Mike Chen: Noted. If Ravi travels for training, please use the travel form and mark as training so expenses route correctly. Payroll will remain CA until we receive amendment approval.

Olivia Torres (Immigration): Filing scheduled for tomorrow with premium. I'll post the receipt number once we have it and attach the ETA.

hr-bot: Reminder — upload the LCA posting screenshot and any employee acknowledgements to the case folder within 10 business days to comply with DOL posting requirements.
